server_scripts.name: SITREP — Compute Window and Check Existing
server_scripts.script:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytz

kuwait_tz = pytz.timezone("Asia/Kuwait")
now = datetime.now(kuwait_tz)
end_time = now.replace(hour=12, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
start_time = end_time - timedelta(days=1)
start_datetime = start_time.astimezone(pytz.UTC)
end_datetime = end_time.astimezone(pytz.UTC)

result["report_date"] = now.date().isoformat()
result["data_period_start"] = start_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
result["data_period_end"] = end_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
result["already_generated"] = bool(
	frappe.db.exists("Threat Assessment Report", {"report_date": now.date()})
)
result["generation_status"] = "OK"

server_scripts.name: SITREP — Create Draft Report
server_scripts.script:
report = frappe.get_doc({
	"doctype": "Threat Assessment Report",
	"report_date": task_data.get("report_date"),
	"report_time": "12:00:00",
	"data_period_start": task_data.get("data_period_start"),
	"data_period_end": task_data.get("data_period_end"),
	"generation_status": "Draft",
})
report.insert()
frappe.db.commit()

result["report_name"] = report.name

server_scripts.name: SITREP — Collect and Classify Threats
SITREP — Mark No Activity
server_scripts.script:
report_name = task_data.get("report_name")
if report_name:
	frappe.db.set_value("Threat Assessment Report", report_name, {
		"generation_status": "Generated",
		"executive_summary": "No threats detected in the last 24 hours.",
		"total_threats": 0,
		"security_threats_count": 0,
		"environmental_threats_count": 0,
	})
	frappe.db.commit()
result["generation_status"] = "Generated"

server_scripts.name: SITREP — Finalize Tool
server_scripts.script:
# The tool the AI Agent Task calls. Its own call arguments arrive as task_data;
# copying them into result is what surfaces the full structured assessment as
# sitrep_agent_task's finalize_sitrep_toolCallResult for the next Script Task.
result.update(task_data)
result["captured"] = True

server_scripts.name: SITREP — Apply Output and Render PDF
server_scripts.script:
from frappe.utils.pdf import get_pdf

report_name = task_data.get("report_name")
insights = task_data.get("finalize_sitrep_toolCallResult")

if not report_name:
	result["generation_status"] = "Failed"
else:
	report = frappe.get_doc("Threat Assessment Report", report_name)
	try:
		if not insights:
			raise ValueError("AI agent did not return a finalize_sitrep result")

		report.executive_summary = insights.get("executive_summary", "")
		report.security_insights = "\n\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in insights.get("security_insights", []))
		report.environmental_insights = "\n\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in insights.get("environmental_insights", []))
		report.geographic_analysis = "\n\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in insights.get("geographic_analysis", []))
		report.trend_analysis = "\n\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in insights.get("trend_analysis", []))

		security_threats = insights.get("security_threats") or []
		environmental_threats = insights.get("environmental_threats") or []
		report.total_threats = len(security_threats) + len(environmental_threats)
		report.security_threats_count = len(security_threats)
		report.environmental_threats_count = len(environmental_threats)

		report.set("security_threats", [])
		for t in security_threats:
			report.append("security_threats", {
				"name_field": t.get("name"),
				"threat_level": t.get("threat_level"),
				"location": t.get("location"),
			})
		report.set("environmental_threats", [])
		for t in environmental_threats:
			report.append("environmental_threats", {
				"name_field": t.get("name"),
				"threat_level": t.get("threat_level"),
				"location": t.get("location"),
			})

		context = {
			"report_date": report.report_date.strftime("%d-%m-%y") if report.report_date else "",
			"data_period_start": frappe.utils.get_datetime(report.data_period_start).strftime("%d-%m-%y %H:%M") if report.data_period_start else "",
			"data_period_end": frappe.utils.get_datetime(report.data_period_end).strftime("%d-%m-%y %H:%M") if report.data_period_end else "",
			"total_threats": report.total_threats,
			"security_threats_count": report.security_threats_count,
			"environmental_threats_count": report.environmental_threats_count,
			"executive_summary": insights.get("executive_summary", "N/A"),
			"security_insights": insights.get("security_insights", []),
			"environmental_insights": insights.get("environmental_insights", []),
			"geographic_analysis": insights.get("geographic_analysis", []),
			"trend_analysis": insights.get("trend_analysis", []),
			"security_threats": security_threats[:20],
			"environmental_threats": environmental_threats[:20],
			"generation_time": frappe.utils.now_datetime().strftime("%d-%m-%y %H:%M"),
		}
		html = frappe.render_template("one_bpmn/templates/threat_assessment_sitrep_report.html", context)
		pdf_data = get_pdf(html)

		file_doc = frappe.get_doc({
			"doctype": "File",
			"file_name": f"Threat_Report_{report.report_date}.pdf",
			"attached_to_doctype": "Threat Assessment Report",
			"attached_to_name": report.name,
			"content": pdf_data,
			"is_private": 1,
		})
		file_doc.save()

		report.report_pdf = file_doc.file_url
		report.generation_status = "Generated"
		report.save()
		frappe.db.commit()

		result["generation_status"] = "Generated"
	except Exception as e:
		error_msg = "Error finalizing report: " + frappe.get_traceback()
		frappe.log_error(title="SITREP Finalize Error", message=error_msg)
		report.generation_status = "Failed"
		report.error_log = error_msg[:9000]
		report.save()
		frappe.db.commit()
		result["generation_status"] = "Failed"
